body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Samsung Electronics expects to reveal its fitting wall mounting system for these new generation of ultra-thin LED backlit LCD HDTVs at CES 2009, which really start to look like a normal picture frame when hung on a wall. The company promises to reduce wall damage considerably with this new mounting system and Samsung's new ultra-slim LED TV.
